purpose: Three predeclared P1 k5 shared-input mechanism probes; prepare first, wait for root execution signal
algorithm_name: P1 active cores and local input windows
method: Compare at most requested K static component-pack and Task input-window metadata configurations; choose active cores by fixed copy/work proxy; call bounded constructor once; refine each chosen base Task into local depth/input windows; pad inactive core schedules. No online scorer or quality guarantee.
stop_policy: First constructor/E0/source/resource/cleanup failure stops the batch; no retry; retain remaining not_run
coordination: Preparation only: wait-P2. Parent reports P2 holds the next six-cell window, at most 600 seconds; do not run until root explicitly sends execute after release. Then one nonexclusive worker, no Colab/GPU; record the new authorization receipt.

comparison_source.scope: Exact old bounded04 same-cell plans/results and official singlecore originals reused; no baseline calls
